quotes.text: Normally a page (or document) should have exactly one Redux store being used.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The frontend guide recommends one shared store per page, with frequently reused controls keeping instance-local state and receiving document state through attributes or methods. It explains why a globally shared system module could couple tabs. This is documented design intent, not verified page isolation or adoption. The examples need correction against the actual constructor and declared identifiers; they are not tested recipes. This study leaves deliberate project instructions unchanged.
title: The state-management guide scopes shared frontend data to one page instance
